negative_reviews.author: Zara
negative_reviews.text: I tried this place with family back in January 2026. Sadly, approximately an hour later, I began to gag and feel nauseous for an unknown reason. I’m not sure if it was the food, or just a common sickness from other people around me. I felt nauseous and i had a lack of energy for 2 weeks straight. The atmosphere is nice here however i’m not sure if I’d like to try again due to the incident.
